Invoice numbers should be generated automatically in the following format:</p>
<p>INV-YYYY-Series</p>
<p>🔧 Format Details:<br>
INV: Fixed prefix</p>
<p>YYYY: Financial year based on the Issue Date</p>
<p>Series: A sequential number (e.g., 001, 002, 003, ...) — can be reset or continued based on your preference</p>
<p>📅 Financial Year Rule (India):<br>
The financial year in India runs from 1st April to 31st March.</p>
<p>For example:</p>
<p>An Issue Date of May 10, 2025 will belong to financial year 2025 → INV-2025-001</p>
<p>An Issue Date of February 15, 2026 will also belong to financial year 2025</p>
<p>An Issue Date of April 1, 2026 will belong to financial year 2026</p>
<p>📥 Invoice Import:<br>
Invoices will be imported via Excel.</p>
<p>The system must generate the correct invoice number automatically based on the Issue Date in the imported file.</p>
<p>🔁 Example:<br>
INV-2025-001</p>
<p>INV-2025-002</p>
<p>INV-2026-001 (starts fresh for new FY)</p></div></div></div></span><div class=" useView_view__C2mnv useView_isHorizontal__Q1YOp" style="--useView--gap: 4px; --useView--pr: 8px; --useView--pl: 8px;"><div class=" useView_view__C2mnv"><span class=" useView_view__C2mnv css-85lk56" data-chromatic="ignore" tabindex="0"><span class=" useView_view__C2mnv Text_text__T_hn_ Text_singleLine__lXpWA" style="--Text--font-family: inherit;
